title: Prevent Stale Database Reads in Laravel 13.38
content:
Laravel 13.38 adds PreventStaleDatabaseReads middleware and DB::usingWritePdo() so users see their own writes when you read from database replicas.

The post Prevent Stale Database Reads in Laravel 13.38 appeared first on Laravel News.
